name: Argus-V-em class-weight check
scores: cross-validation inside the train split (scenario-family folds); test and validation were not read

metrics.min3: same-tool AUROC, visible violations, cells with >=3 (main metric)
metrics.pooled_all: all calls, tools mixed, normal vs any violation
metrics.pooled_visible: all normal calls + visible violations, tools mixed
metrics.logloss_unweighted: binary cross entropy without class weight on normal + visible rows
